answer: An agent economy resists Sybils with work-bonded identity: every identity must lock a refundable stake and earn standing on the mesa of verified work receipts, one task at a time. Reputation enters only through a single narrow inlet, signed receipts from established peers, so a fresh fake has no history to spend. Cloning a thousand identities means locking a thousand stakes and doing a thousand real jobs, and an onyx-hard slashing rule burns the stake of any identity caught attesting its own clones. Attacker cost scales linearly with every fake; honest agents pay once and keep the bond.
